desc: Derive the transformation from original `1` positions to adjusted positions `pos[i] - i`.
Prove that choosing the median adjusted position minimizes the total number of adjacent swaps.
Implement an \(O(N)\) scan to collect positions of `1`s from stdin.
Compute the sum of absolute differences from the median using Python integers.
Produce a Python solution that writes the resulting minimum to stdout.
Verify the implementation against all provided sample cases.
